sloka: जामातरं न जाने स्म प्रहरन्युद्धदुर्मदः ।तेनासौ निहतः सङ्ख्ये मया भर्ता तव स्वसः ।। ७.२४.३४ ॥
transliteration: jāmātaraṁ na jāne sma praharanyuddhadurmadaḥ ।tenāsau nihataḥ saṅkhye mayā bhartā tava svasaḥ ।। 7.24.34 ॥

translations.english: Ravana confessed that, maddened by the battle, he did not recognize his son-in-law while striking and thus inadvertently killed her husband in the conflict.
